findings.current: , dont {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} non active} many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de non actives} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} non actives}}.
findings.problem: The elsewhere tail names the backend class with a bare adjective and uses 'non actives' where this catalogue renders that class 'inactive': ui.chat.pickers.destination_pickers.cold_no_owner_running 'inactive (aucun propriétaire actif)' and every_canonical_session_live_or_cold 'Toutes les sessions canoniques, actives ou inactives.'. 'non actives' is a calque of the English 'not active' and, beside 'non lues' in the same sentence, reads stiff. The ellipsis itself is idiomatic after 'conversations' ('dont deux inactifs' is normal French), so the noun can stay in the main clause - but the many branch the guide requires puts the partitive on an adjective with no head ('dont 1000000 de non actives'), which is ungrammatical. Meaning, placeholders and ICU structure are exact; the defect is idiomatic, plus grammatical in many.
findings.suggested: , dont {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} inactive} many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de conversations inactives} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} inactives}}.
findings.evidence: Shipped fr at head 28a6127; siblings quoted from src/i18n/catalogues/fr/ui.chat.pickers.json. Composed here with the code's own arguments: count=5,elsewhere=2 -> 'Marquer 5 conversations non lues comme lues, dont 2 non actives.'; count=1000000,elsewhere=1000000 -> '...dont 1000000 de non actives.'. many needs an exact multiple of 10^6 unread AND not-active conversations - practically unreachable, hence minor not major.

findings.current: , dont {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} non active} many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de non actives} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} non actives}}
findings.problem: Appended directly to the label (chat-sidebar.tsx:2362-2364, an sr-only span, no separator added by code) this reads 'Tout marquer comme lu (5), dont 2 non actives'. The label it continues names no noun, so the adjective has no antecedent anywhere in the accessible name and a screen-reader user hears an unfinished clause; English at least carries the relative clause 'that are not active'. Same 'non actives' vs the catalogue's 'inactive', and the same headless 'de non actives' in many. The WCAG 2.5.3 requirement holds: the suffix begins with the comma and the label stays a prefix.
findings.suggested: , dont {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} conversation inactive} many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de conversations inactives} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} conversations inactives}}
findings.evidence: Composed name at count=5,elsewhere=2: 'Tout marquer comme lu (5), dont 2 non actives' against label 'Tout marquer comme lu ({count, number, ::group-off})'. Append site read in src/renderer/src/features/chat/components/chat-sidebar.tsx.

findings.current: one {{count, number, ::group-off} marque non lue sans accusé d’achèvement ne peut pas être effacée.} ... other {{count, number, ::group-off} marques non lues sans accusé d’achèvement ne peuvent pas être effacées.}
findings.problem: 'accusé d’achèvement' for 'completion token' is a coinage. Both halves exist in the corpus ('accusé de réception' for a receipt, 'date d’achèvement' for a completion date), so it is understandable and not unsafe, and 'marque non lue' plus 'effacée' match ui.chat.read_ack exactly. But the fr style guide keeps 'token' English (kept-English list: 'token, cache, endpoint, script, prompt') and every sibling key does render it as 'token' (ui.agents.settings.chat.max_tokens 'Tokens maximum'), while 'achèvement' is used in this corpus for a completion DATE, not for a run finishing - so the phrase asks the reader to infer the mechanism the sentence exists to explain.
findings.suggested: one {{count, number, ::group-off} marque non lue sans token d’achèvement ne peut pas être effacée.} many {...} other {{count, number, ::group-off} marques non lues sans token d’achèvement ne peuvent pas être effacées.} - or keep the receipt family and say 'sans accusé de fin'
